scenes.text: Three secrets are hiding on a twenty-dollar bill. Number three stops a machine.
scenes.head: ON A $20 BILL

scenes.text: One. It's not paper. 75% cotton, 25% linen.
scenes.say: One. It's not paper. Seventy-five percent cotton, twenty-five percent linen.
scenes.head: #1 · NOT PAPER

scenes.text: Two. Tilt it. The number in the corner shifts from copper to green.
scenes.head: #2 · TILT IT

scenes.text: Three. Tiny yellow twenties on the back. Their zeros form a pattern of five rings.
scenes.head: #3 · FIVE RINGS

scenes.text: Many color copiers spot that pattern... and refuse to copy.
scenes.head: THE MACHINE SAYS NO

scenes.text: Whoa... the bill tells on you?!
scenes.head: IT TELLS ON YOU

scenes.text: Which one did you already know? Go check a twenty, because...
scenes.head: WHICH DID YOU KNOW?
